Fit a Poisson GLM baseline model

Source: R/models_baseline.R
fit_poisson_glm.Rd

Fits a simple Poisson GLM on goals with attack/defence strengths and home advantage. This is the mandatory baseline model that all advanced models must beat.

Usage

fit_poisson_glm(long_df)

Arguments

long_df

A long-format tibble from matches_to_long().

Value

A fitted glm object.
